Translations.bn_smooth_desc: Physics simulation is at full rate (PTR 100%), frame rate is stable, and jitter is minimal.
Translations.bn_smooth_tip: System performance is optimal under the current flight condition and vessel size.
Translations.bn_physx_title: 🛑 Physics Engine & Joint Overload (PhysX & Joints Bound)
Translations.bn_physx_desc: Physics calculation is exceeding frame budget ({0:F1}ms), PTR dropped to {1:F1}% (Yellow/Red simulation clock).
Translations.bn_physx_tip: Main causes: Too many parts on active vessel, excessive AutoStruts, complex docking/collision meshes. Suggestions: Simplify vessel parts, reduce autostrut usage, install KSPCommunityFixes.
Translations.bn_plugin_title: 🛑 Global Mod Plugin Script Overload (Mod Plugin Overhead)
Translations.bn_plugin_desc: External Mod Plugin Managers are consuming {0:F1}ms per frame ({1:F1}% of frame budget).
Translations.bn_plugin_tip: Inspect the 'Global Plugins' tab to locate the heaviest mods (e.g. Scatterer, EVE, Principia, background simulations).
Translations.bn_module_desc: Vessel PartModule scripts are taking {0:F1}ms per frame ({1:F1}% of frame budget).
Translations.bn_module_tip: Specific modules on your vessel (e.g., Waterfall visual effects, FAR aerodynamics, resource converters) are consuming significant CPU cycles.
Translations.bn_gpu_title: 🛑 GPU Graphics & Shaders Bottleneck (GPU / Render Bound)
Translations.bn_gpu_desc: GPU rendering and draw wait is taking {0:F1}ms ({1:F1}% of frame budget), while CPU scripts are lightweight.
Translations.bn_gpu_tip: Main causes: High display resolution, heavy post-processing (TUFX/anti-aliasing), Parallax terrain shaders, volumetric clouds. Suggestions: Lower shadow cascade distance or antialiasing.
Translations.bn_tufx_desc: TUFX post-processing takes {0:F1}ms ({1:F1}% of frame), running {2} active effect passes.
Translations.bn_tufx_tip: Consider disabling heavy screen-space passes (GTAO, SSGI, SSR) or lowering AA level (TAA/SMAA) in TUFX profile settings. Press F11 anytime to toggle Master Bypass and benchmark vanilla performance.
Translations.bn_stutter_desc: Average FPS is {0:F1}, but 1% Low plummeted to {1:F1} FPS with high jitter ({2:F1}ms).
Translations.bn_stutter_tip: Main causes: Unity Mono garbage collection (GC) pauses, burst disk/audio I/O, or cyclic mod routines. Suggestions: Install MemGraph / HeapPadder to pad Mono heap and prevent frequent GC cycles.
Translations.graph_title: Real-time Frame Time History (Last 100 Frames) - Spikes indicate micro-stutters
Translations.help_ptr_a:
• 100% (Green): 1 sec in physics = 1 sec in real world.
• <80% (Yellow): Physics is lagging; game clock turns yellow and slow-motion occurs.
• <50% (Red): CPU physics thread is fully saturated; vessel simplification required.
Translations.help_1pct_q: What are 1% Low and 0.1% Low FPS?
Translations.help_1pct_a:
• 1% Low: The 99th percentile slowest frames. Indicates real-world stuttering. If Avg FPS is 60 but 1% Low is 15, the game will feel visibly jerky.
• 0.1% Low: Severe freeze spikes (usually caused by GC sweeps or burst operations).
Translations.help_jitter_a: • Standard deviation of frame times. Below 2ms is exceptionally smooth; above 6ms causes prominent tearing and uneven pacing.
Translations.help_mod_tuning_a:
1. Physics Lag: Install KSPCommunityFixes and avoid excessive AutoStruts.
2. GC Hitching: Install HeapPadder / MemGraph to allocate a larger heap cushion.
3. GPU Lag: Tweak Scatterer / TUFX antialiasing and Parallax terrain tessellation settings.
